title: Predual and tight operator systems
summary: Given a (not necessarily unital) complete operator system $S$ with a generating cone, there are some studies in literature on the operator system dual $S^\mathrm{d}$ of $S$, i.e., the dual matrix-ordered space $S^*$ equipped with a matrix norm that turns it into a dual operator system satisfying certain universal property. In order to do further study on $S^\mathrm{d}$, one needs to consider the operator system predual construction.
